positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Planning, configuration, documentation, and implementation of ECM (Enterprise Content Management) solutions. Document capture design, work-flow and process’s to maximize workplace efficiencies and streamline process. The support, enhancement, and expansion of customer’s existing ECM solutions.

positions.title: Application Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Assisting in the upgrade and design of current; IBM FileNet P8 system, IBM Image Services 4.0, Kofax Capture, and related workflow. Assist with design, development and trouble shooting of custom in house applications. Provide recommendations to improve systems performance, stability and throughput. Provide hardware and configuration sizing for server upgrades and replacements.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description: 24x7 Management and maintenance of business critical imaging and workflow applications, and Third tier support for the imaging systems issues for hardware, software and applications. Creation of Kofax models, batch classes for electronic document classification, separation and data extraction. Third tier support and administration of IBM FileNet Image Services 4.0 software with over 2000 users. Technical project management of multiple high priority projects, management of 3 Systems Engineers. Management of software upgrades, security patches and projects for IIS Web servers, RightFax servers, SQL 2000/2005 servers, and multiple Application servers totaling over 80 servers.

positions.title: Senior Desktop Engineer
positions.description: Created and maintained standard Image for campus Windows 2000 Professional workstations. Created and maintained GPO for Campus workstations. Implemented and administered Windows 2000 file server for centralization of all software and instructions.  Implemented change process for all instructions as well as software updates.  Software testing of over 100 applications to insure apps that were deployed on Windows 95/NT was compatible with Windows 2000 professional.  Worked with application vendors to resolve application compatibility issues with Windows 2000 professional. Created detailed installation instruction for application.  Supported hardware and software for over 700 campus users.

positions.title: Network Admin
positions.description:
Manage Deployment team to install and configured server and workstations in Ohio Counties with multiple sites. Installed and configured over 100 Novell 4.11 servers. Resolution of all hardware and software issues on the workstations and servers.  Deployed over 5,000 workstations. Managed and updated asset tracking and detailed documentation for each site. Created daily reports for team members and management that provided site progress, project issues and corrective actions implemented. The State of Illinois Windows 2000 network implementation
Responsibilities: created detailed instructions for server installations, hardware installations. Assisted in streamlining site installation and implementation process.
